extraction.name: Visual Genome
extraction.description: Visual Genome is a dataset of over 100K images densely annotated with objects, attributes, relationships, region descriptions, and question-answer pairs to enable cognitive visual understanding.
extraction.creator: Ranjay Krishna, Yuke Zhu, Oliver Groth, Justin Johnson, Kenji Hata, Joshua Kravitz, Stephanie Chen, Yannis Kalantidis, Li-Jia Li, David A. Shamma, Michael S. Bernstein, Li Fei-Fei
extraction.citeAs: Krishna, R., Zhu, Y., Groth, O., Johnson, J., Hata, K., Kravitz, J., Chen, S., Kalantidis, Y., Li, L.-J., Shamma, D.A., Bernstein, M.S., & Fei-Fei, L. (2016). Visual Genome: Connecting Language and Vision Using Crowdsourced Dense Image Annotations. arXiv:1602.07332.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was collected via crowdsourcing on Amazon Mechanical Turk. Images were selected from the intersection of YFCC100M and MS-COCO. Workers provided region descriptions, objects, attributes, relationships, and question-answer pairs.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Images from the intersection of YFCC100M and MS-COCO datasets.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionTimeframe: The dataset was collected over 6 months after 15 months of experimentation.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Region descriptions were filtered using BLEU score thresholds to ensure diversity. Objects, attributes, and relationships were extracted from descriptions and canonicalized to WordNet synsets. Verification was done via majority voting and rapid judgments.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Crowd workers on Amazon Mechanical Turk provided region descriptions, extracted objects with bounding boxes, attributes, relationships, and question-answer pairs. Workers were instructed to follow specific rules for quality and diversity.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Verification was conducted using majority voting (three workers per annotation) and rapid judgments for objects. Annotations were accepted if at least two out of three workers verified correctness.
extraction.rai:annotationsPerItem: 42 region descriptions, 21 objects, 18 attributes, 18 relationships, 17 question-answer pairs per image on average.
extraction.rai:annotatorDemographics: 93.02% from United States, 54.15% male, 45.85% female, majority aged 25-34.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: Stanford dependency parser, Stanford NLP tools, WordNet
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Gender, age, and location of crowd workers were collected for demographic analysis.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset is biased towards images of people and sports; top synsets include 'ski', 'ballplayer', 'racket'.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset may have biases towards certain object categories and image types. Canonicalization to WordNet may introduce errors.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training and benchmarking for object detection, attribute prediction, relationship prediction, image captioning, visual question answering, and scene graph generation.
